decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 4 - The crossover shall be constructed in accordance with approved plan and shall not exceed 3.6 meters in width.

Condition : 5 - The approved car parking area in the front garden shall be a maximum of 4.8 metres in width and 4.8 metres in depth and shall be constructed of a porous surface material (such as block paviours). The area to the left of the parking space shall be maintained as soft landscaping. A path to the front door of the dwelling known as 402 Bath Road, Hounslow shall be implemented in the space to the right of the approved parking space. A boundary wall with a maximum height of 0.6 metres shall be erected along the entire length of the Bath road frontage of the property excluding that area occupied by the vehicle crossing within 6 months of the completion of the means of vehicle access.
description: Formation of a vehicular access to the front of the property
